extra.final_summary: Found and fixed several data issues affecting the average body mass by sex. (1) One exact duplicate row (row 59) was removed. (2) One label 'FEMALE' was normalized to 'female'. (3) The body mass column was converted from text to numeric, correctly parsing '4,925'. (3) Three body mass values (rows 9, 20, 49) were excluded for being impossibly high (millions of grams). (4) One flipper length value (row 1) was excluded for being negative and out of range. After these fixes, the average body mass is 3792.86 grams for females and 4492.00 grams for males.
